caseStudy.title: KMP Template
caseStudy.lead: A production-ready starting point for Kotlin Multiplatform apps: a modular clean architecture with YAMVIP and Anubis, a 100% Compose Android app, a 100% SwiftUI iOS app and CI from the first commit.

brief.title: The idea
text: Every new KMP project used to start with the same week of setup. The template packs the team's decisions into a repository that builds on both platforms from day one.
New apps start from proven structure instead of a blank page.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Worked on the multi-module clean architecture and the Gradle convention plugin.
Wired in SQLDelight, Koin dependency injection and Moko resources.
Integrated YAMVIP presenters and Anubis server-driven UI.
Worked on the Compose Android app with NavHost and the SwiftUI iOS app with NavigationStack, generated with Tuist.
Set up CI that builds both apps, with the version from a file and the build number from CI.

team.title: Team
team.text: Built by the internal mobile engineering team at Merkle, as internal reference work.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: A template the team could start new KMP projects from, with architecture, tooling and CI already decided.
